threads.body:
nitpicking on the env var name (MESSAGE part):

we use it in python for everything:

input and output messages (good), `gen_ai.system_instructions`, tool arguments and responses, memory records. 

Can we do this?

- keep supporting this env var in python
- additionally document + support a more accurate name like `OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_CONTENT`
- In declarative config support more options (maybe start with one and add more later)

```yaml
instrumentation/development:
  general:
    gen_ai:
      capture_content: span_and_event # enables it all
      capture_system_instructions: span_and_event  # alternatively, enable them one by one
      capture_input_messages: span_and_event 
      ...
```

or 

```yaml
instrumentation/development:
  general:
    gen_ai:
      capture_content: 
        mode: span_and_event
        attributes: ["gen_ai.system_instructions", "gen_ai.input.messages", ...] # any combination, defaults to all
```

or nest all content options under one node:

```yaml
instrumentation/development:
  general:
    gen_ai:
      content:
        capture: 
          mode: span_and_event
          attributes: ["gen_ai.system_instructions", "gen_ai.input.messages", ...] # any combination, defaults to all
        upload:
          base_path: ...
          ....
```


------

also we might want (in the future) to provide per-operation control (e.g. capture on inference level, but not agent or vice versa), so we'd add levels of nesting like 


```yaml
instrumentation/development:
  general:
    gen_ai:
      inference:
        capture_content: 
          mode: span_and_event
          attributes: ["gen_ai.system_instructions", "gen_ai.input.messages", ...] # any combination, defaults to all
      invoke_agent:
        capture_content: 
          mode: no_content
```

This seems like easy to do later no matter which approach we take now

I feel like the best schema is something like:


```
instrumentation/development:
  general:
    gen_ai:
      content:
        capture:
          # Signal sink selector (default: NO_CONTENT)
          mode: span_and_event
          # Optional global attribute filter (defaults to all content attributes if omitted)
          attributes:
            - gen_ai.input.messages
            - gen_ai.output.messages
          # Optional per-span attribute overrides
          spans:
            # Empty list disables all content capture on this span type
            execute_tool: []
            # Specific list overrides the global list for this span type
            memory:
              - gen_ai.memory.query.text
```
